explication: simple-one-api is a multi-provider LLM gateway with OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages interfaces, plus a web chat/configuration console and Wails desktop app. The main user path is client or web chat → gateway protocol handling → provider-specific upstream → streamed/result response. Administrators initialize or edit configuration, test providers, and inspect capacity, logs, and usage statistics. README statements establish several backend capabilities; sampled frontend excerpts show chat and admin API calls. Backend routing details and most provider implementations were not sampled, so those links are documented at subsystem level.
